verdict.rationale: Better Auth maintains an official Auth0-to-Better-Auth migration guide. It covers moving email/password users "with proper hashing", plus social accounts and 2FA, which implies existing password hashes carry over rather than forcing resets. Missing for 10: guides or tooling for competitors beyond Auth0, an explicit statement that users keep their passwords without a reset, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a password-preserving migration.
